claims: Colman Domingo was born on November 28, 1969.
Colman Domingo was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
Colman Domingo is an American actor, playwright, director, and producer.
Colman Domingo played Ali in Euphoria.
Colman Domingo played Victor Strand in Fear the Walking Dead.
Colman Domingo played Bayard Rustin in Rustin.
Colman Domingo played Mister in The Color Purple (2023).
Colman Domingo won a Primetime Emmy in 2022 for Outstanding Guest Actor in a Drama Series for Euphoria.
Colman Domingo has received nominations for Tony, Olivier, Golden Globe, and SAG awards.
Colman Domingo founded Edith Productions.
Edith Productions has a first-look deal with AMC.
Colman Domingo has been married to Raúl Domingo since 2014.
Colman Domingo and Raúl Domingo met in a Walgreens parking lot in 2005.
Colman Domingo was nominated for a Tony Award in 2023 as a producer for Fat Ham.
Colman Domingo had acting roles in the Broadway productions The Scottsboro Boys and Passing Strange.
Colman Domingo starred in Ma Rainey's Black Bottom.
Colman Domingo starred in If Beale Street Could Talk.
Colman Domingo starred in Selma.
Colman Domingo starred in Zola.
Colman Domingo starred in Sing Sing.

Colman Domingo has taught at Yale and Juilliard.
Colman Domingo has been a creative associate at Yale and Juilliard.
